notes.title: Performance Update after Console Release preparations
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38955177/7bf1124448401cb799b9a3e14ba5eaf1cd8d7731.png[/img]

Celebrate one year of Afterthought since our Early-Access Release on Nov 30th 2021! To get an [b]exclusive player skin and speed trail[/b], go to the Options menu inside the game and enter the Promo Code:
[b]SPECTACLE[/b]

After we have prepared the game for an upcoming Console Release, we have decided to also submit all the drastical Performance Enhancements to Steam.

When you set Afterthought to its lowest settings (ArtworkMode = None, TextureQuality = Performance), the game should now even run smooth on the oldest PCs, that fulfill the hardware requirements. Even if you leave Afterthought on its highest settings, your CPU will feel the difference!

Even the best game can still be improved.

notes.title: Afterthought - Full Release
notes.notes:
We are Studio Moondowner and we want to introduce our debut game, Afterthought, a 2D speedrun-platformer. This is the fruit of 7 years of work.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38955177/6f35011647760176720da83938caa3e7607cbf12.png[/img]


Features?

[b]Surreal and Colorful World[/b]
8 unique worlds, each with their own art direction, level design and musical direction

[b]Unique Skill System[/b]
We created 5 skills that each feel different and can complement each other. The game was carefully designed to be possibly cleared by each skill individually or in conjunction.

[b]Active Leader Boards with many sorting options[/b]
Our leader boards come with a ghost system for replay, studying and competing. Each record can also be sorted by skill combination. Meaning you are not bound to any playstyle and can compare with similar records.

[b]8 Crazy Bosses[/b]
The player will face 8 different bosses, each with distinct visual designs and creative ways to challenge the movement system. You might have to run away or chase someone, who knows?

[b]6 Hours of Soundtrack in 100 Individual Tracks[/b]
The creation of the soundtrack itself also started 7 years ago, while the main bulk was produced over the last 3 years. The soundtrack switches genres with each world and spans from techno, industrial, classic to folk and jazz.

notes.title: Patchnotes - Version 1.3.000 - Date 21.12.2021
notes.notes:
[b]ALL 40 BASE LEVELS ARE COMPLETE AND RELEASED NOW[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38955177/bb15fe1230fdc912ad7a78c078e3b943bb1871ec.png[/img]

- Added: 12 new Levels for Cycles 6, 7 and 8 (4 new Levels for each Cycle)
- Added: Bonus Objectives and Skins for all new Levels
- Added: All Scenic Shots for the Levels in Cycle 6, 7 and 8
- Added: Speedrun Mode with all 40 Base Levels

- New: Scenic Shots finetuned, accurate walkspeeds, better lighting, control direction reworked

- Fixed: Dash Slide-Offs now work consistently on 45° ceilings

notes.title: Patchnotes - Version 1.2.000 - Date 14.12.2021
notes.notes:

- Added: 12 new Levels for Cycles 2, 4 and 5 (4 new Levels for each Cycle)
- Added: Bonus Objectives and Skins for all new Levels
- Added: All Scenic Shots for the Levels in Cycle 2, 3, 4 and 5
